第49章 陪了夫人的赵贵-《赶山1957：二斤猪肉换个媳妇》

上一章

存书签

“救命啊，救命啊……赵瞎子，你快放手，你快放手……！”赵贵婆娘反应了过来，开始挣扎起来。

“啪！”

下一秒。

赵瞎子一巴掌摔在四五十岁赵贵婆娘的脸上，训斥道：“闭嘴，没听到你家男人说了，要把你送给我，再敢乱叫喊，我掐死你！”

赵瞎子的一句话，顿时将赵贵婆娘吓得浑身又是一颤。

人在遇到危险，很多时候是被吓得指挥不了自己身体的，更何况是眼前如此疯狂的赵瞎子。

而赵贵婆娘，不过是一个一辈子都没出过乡镇的乡下婆娘。

三分钟后！

赵贵视线逐渐恢复，望着床上的婆娘，还有躺在床上一脸悠闲自得的赵瞎子，只觉得脑袋又是一懵。

“赵赵赵……赵瞎子，你……你，你干什么了？”

“你干什么了？”

赵贵指着床上哭泣的婆娘，还有已经穿好衣裳的赵瞎子，声音都有些颤抖起来。

“玩婆娘啊！”

“不是你说要送我个婆娘吗？”

“不过，赵贵，这么好的婆娘你怎么不要了？”

“多好啊！”

赵瞎子一脸疑惑道。

“赵瞎子，我干你娘……！”

赵贵一声怒吼，顿时朝着赵瞎子冲了过去，二人立刻扭打在了一起。

“别打了，别打了，当家的……！”

五分钟后！

两个中年男人气喘吁吁，赵贵看向赵瞎子的眼神能杀人。

“当家的，要不我们报告政府吧？”赵贵婆娘一脸委屈道。

“不是，不是你送我的婆娘的吗？怎么还报告政府，你们在玩仙人跳不是？”

“告诉你们，我可不怕你们！”

“是你们自己送上门的，自己要把婆娘送给我的。”

“娘的，老子烂命一条，你们要是敢报告政府，我先去把你儿子弄死。”

赵瞎子连忙吓唬赵贵道。

沉默！

"Help, help... Blind Zhao, let go quickly, let go...!" Madam Zhao Gui reacted and began to struggle.

"Crack!"

The next second.

Blind Zhao slapped Mrs. Zhao Gui, who was in her 40s or 50s, on the face and reprimanded: "Shut up, I didn't hear your man say that he wants to give you to me. If you dare to scream again, I will strangle you to death!"

Blind Zhao's words immediately frightened Mrs. Zhao Gui so much that she trembled all over again.

When people encounter danger, they are often too frightened to control their bodies, not to mention the crazy blind Zhao in front of them.

And Mrs. Zhao Gui is just a country woman who has never been out of the countryside in her life.

Three minutes later!

Zhao Gui's vision gradually recovered, and he looked at the mother-in-law on the bed, as well as the blind Zhao who was lying on the bed with a leisurely and contented look, and felt that his head was confused again.

"Zhao Zhao Zhao... Blind Zhao, you... you, what did you do?"

"What did you do?"

Zhao Gui pointed to the crying mother-in-law on the bed and the blind Zhao who had already put on his clothes, his voice trembling.

"Playing like a bitch!"

"Didn't you say you wanted to give me a wife?"

"But, Zhao Gui, why don't you want such a good woman?"

"How wonderful!"

Blind Zhao said with a puzzled look.

"Blind Zhao, I will fuck your mother...!"

Zhao Gui roared and rushed towards Blind Zhao, and the two immediately started fighting.

"Stop fighting, stop fighting, the boss...!"

Five minutes later!

The two middle-aged men were panting, and Zhao Gui looked at Blind Zhao with a look that could kill.

"Master, why don't we report it to the government?" Mrs. Zhao Gui said with an aggrieved look.

"No, didn't you give it to my mother-in-law? Why did you report it to the government? Are you playing fairy dance?"

"Let me tell you, I'm not afraid of you!"

"You brought it to my door yourself, and you wanted to give it to me."

"Damn, I'm going to die. If you dare to report it to the government, I will kill your son first."

Blind Zhao quickly frightened Zhao Guidao.
